root_cause.description: The soak harness computes new_records = total_records_at_window_end - total_records_at_window_start. The start offset was taken after the HTTP requests were fired but before all background asyncio shadow tasks from smoke_probe_2 (concurrency=5, 10 requests) had finished writing to the JSONL file. Two smoke_probe_2 shadow tasks completed after the Y1 offset was captured, so their JSONL records were counted as Y1 new_records.
root_cause.explanation: Each of the 1000 Y1 requests triggered exactly one Pi shadow execution. The 2 extra records belong to smoke_probe_2 requests that completed asynchronously. No Y1 request triggered two Pi executions.
root_cause.safety_impact: none — pi_violations=0, user_visible_source=legacy, pi_user_visible=false. The cross-window overflow does not affect the safety invariant.

fix.description: Replace offset-based counter with timestamp-based attribution. Shadow diagnostics records now include a window_id field set at task creation time (before background scheduling). The harness filters records by window_id rather than file position.
fix.implementation: PiShadowDiagnosticsSink.record() accepts window_id parameter. SoakHarness passes window_id at request time, not at diagnostics collection time.
fix.verifiable: Y1 re-run with fix: new_records=1000, exactly matches requests.total=1000

post_fix_invariant.per_request: exactly one Pi shadow record per selected request
